description: VLCC MT SUVA; hull steel renewal and accommodation refurbishment by Jurong Shipyard; GE supplied turbines and compressors.

milestones.event: Petrobras signed the P-57 FPSO turnkey agreement with SBM Offshore
Jurong Shipyard secured P62 pre-conversion works
GE Oil & Gas won P-58 and P-62 equipment packages
SBM Offshore reported 2008 results and order portfolio

capex.metric: P-57 FPSO turnkey supply contract value
capex.basis: Offshore Magazine: Petrobras signed the formal USD 1.25-billion agreement with SBM Offshore for turnkey supply of the P-57 FPSO; conversion of VLCC Accord in Singapore.

capex.metric: P62 pre-conversion hull and accommodation works
capex.basis: Hart Energy reprint of Sembcorp Marine announcement: approximately S$130 million contract to Jurong Shipyard; Singapore dollars preserved as printed, no conversion.

capex.metric: P-58 and P-62 gas turbine and compressor packages
capex.basis: GE press release: USD 160 million double FPSO unit contract for power generation and compression packages; equipment package only, not an FPSO EPC value.
SBM 2008 results: new orders totalled USD 4,365m, split 67% turnkey and 33% lease and operate; corporate aggregate, not a unit cost.
SBM 2008 results: order portfolio USD 9.25bn, up 16.2%; USD 6.28bn is nondiscounted value of long-term lease contract revenue; corporate aggregate.

capex.metric: SBM Offshore investment in fixed assets in 2008
capex.basis: SBM 2008 results: total capital expenditure USD 999.8m rounded to USD 1.0bn, mainly new lease fleet investment including Espirito Santo, Thunder Hawk semi-submersible, MOPUstor Yme and Deep Panuke MOPU; corporate aggregate.
